verdict.rationale: Bolna's own GitHub repository describes the product as an "end-to-end open source" framework, so its source is publicly readable. However, the evidence never names the specific license. It also does not show whether the hosted platform features (Agent Studio, workflows, dashboard) are included in the open repo or only the core framework. missing for 10: the named OSI license (e.g., MIT/Apache) documented in evidence, confirmation of which product components are open versus proprietary, and independent corroboration of the repo's licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Bolna is the end-to-end open source production ready framework for quickly building LLM based voice driven conversational applications.
